webb: The two-year-old MATILDA WEBB living in the house in 1841 has sat unexplained for months. James Wakefield's mother was Elizabeth WEBB. The child is almost certainly his kin.
trade: He is a mason in every record that gives him a trade: a mason journeyman at Drivers Fields in 1841, a mason in 1851, a mason on the assisted-passage register in 1854. Three clerks in thirteen years and two hemispheres.
open: Richard Wakefield and Elizabeth Webb come from a FamilySearch-derived index rather than the parish book, and there is more than one James Wakefield in Gloucestershire. The birthplace, year and county all agree with the 1851 census, which is why they are here — but the Stroud register would settle it.
